items.title: Tigresses’ batting woes persist in historic Australia ODI opener
items.summary: After Megan Schutt struck twice inside the opening nine deliveries to leave Bangladesh reeling, the visitors were bowled out for 166 in 49.4 overs. Phoebe Litchfield then smashed a blistering 77 off 57 balls as Australia reached the target in just 25.4 overs, with 146 balls to spare.

items.title: Sutherland and Litchfield lead Australia to quick and convincing win in ODI series opener
items.summary: Bangladesh were bowled out for 166 with only Ritu Moni showing any intent with the bat, and it took Australia just 25.4 overs to finish off the chase

items.title: Afghanistan hit back to leave Bangladesh at 317-8
items.summary: Opener Tanzid Hasan Tamim struck a blistering 83 off just 71 balls as Bangladesh made a flying start on the opening day of their one-off Test against Afghanistan at the Zayed Cricket Stadium in Abu Dhabi today.
